title: Brown Lace Top & Western Belt
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy brown hair wears a sheer brown lace top with long sleeves and a ribbon neck tie, layered over a fitted brown jersey top. A black leather belt with an ornate silver buckle cinches a dark lace skirt. A silver pendant necklace and a black leather bag strap complete the look. Her expression is calm. Warm, soft natural light and a blurred street backdrop. Palette of chocolate, black, and silver. Romantic and edgy, in the style of a fall street-style editorial.
workingNotes:
- The lace layers and buckle belt are the key textures.
- Keep the blurred street for a candid feel.
